groups.root_cause: D2 bundled-deps policy covers turndown regardless of implementation-verification gap
groups.evidence: D2 (no runtime installs, deps bundled) is already an accepted owner decision, not contingent on finding a specific historical turndown-install commit; no bundling regression was found either, so there is nothing to re-break.

groups.root_cause: GP9 lifecycle case missing for parent-liveness child-process cleanup
groups.evidence: 939c5ca8 (process lifecycle guard, #103), 77e22a46 (#854/#855 reap idle bridge children), dfff7b87 (#862 propagate client death through Linux re-exec proxy) are the v1 lifecycle-guard lineage; add 'zero child processes over N ticks' + a grandparent-kill case to lifecycle.test.ts as the acceptance gate, per r4.

groups.root_cause: Heartbeat-free readiness design (ties to #1213's read-only stats access decision)
groups.evidence: Simplest single path consistent with the #1213 decision (stats opens sibling DBs readOnly): a row written once at connect plus PID liveness via process.kill replaces any periodic heartbeat timer, so there is no timer to scan sibling DBs in the first place. No fallback chain introduced. Add to TECH-SPEC D3.

groups.root_cause: events.md cross-project theft mechanism no longer exists once D8 removes the events.md code path
groups.evidence: D8 (events.md removed) eliminates the file this bug operated on; fcc44834/7b609f6a fixed a related but distinct stale-reinjection bug, not this one, but the mechanism #1214 depends on (a shared events.md) does not exist in the v2 single-DB design, so there is no code path left to theft the file from.

groups.root_cause: Codex Windows project-source resolution has no live-tested fallback-free answer
groups.evidence: Q11 already settles this: one named project source per host, doctor reports a missing source, no fallback chain. Even if Codex does not answer roots/list on Windows, the design is doctor-reports-missing, not a silent fallback to the mtime heuristic that caused #1210 — so the mechanism that caused the bug (silent fallback) is removed by Q11 regardless of the live-test outcome.

groups.root_cause: ctx_search offset-paging page size must respect the global 16,384 B output cap (ADR-0016 MUST)
groups.evidence: Q2's global 16,384 B cap is a single constant applied everywhere; add a GP4-style case asserting each ctx_search page stays under that cap, closing the gap the row identifies between tool-count (already wont-fix, correctly) and page-size (needs its own test).

groups.root_cause: Self-heal removal (P1/ADR-0002) is one shared decision covering both #1215 and #1191, not two independent verdicts
groups.evidence: d08fe6a6/8d840973 (4-layer self-heal), fb55ed03 (#577), a342dd54/2965d246 (#727/#728 narrowing) show the heal script needed repeated narrowing — evidence the mechanism itself was fragile. ADR-0002 removes the heal step entirely per P1; #1191's unanchored-regex bug and #1215's upstream-coverage question are the same mechanism and get the one decision: self-heal is dropped, replaced by ctx doctor's manual check, stated explicitly in the ADR rather than left implicit.

groups.root_cause: Worktree-label isolation (D3/D4/D12) has a written design but no GP test exercising two concurrent worktrees
groups.evidence: No commit implements worktree-label isolation yet (f6166631 is an unrelated grep match); write the map's own GP test (two worktrees, hits labelled by worktree, own session ranked first) before it counts as covered.

groups.root_cause: ctx_execute_file deny-anchor parsing (~/, //) has only a template placeholder verdict, not a real test
groups.evidence: ISSUE-OUTCOMES-r2's #1075 row was an unfilled template, not an actual answer. Add the real GP case: deny Read(~/secret/**), then call ctx_execute_file on ~/secret/a and assert deny.

groups.root_cause: OpenCode system-message injection must merge into the existing system entry, not append a second message
groups.evidence: D9/D11 already keep the 1-2 injected routing lines; make explicit as an ADR line that on OpenCode these merge into the existing single system message (output.system length unchanged) rather than appending a new one, closing the contradiction the doc itself flagged.

groups.root_cause: Generic server-shutdown contract (stdin EOF -> exit <2s) must survive a runtime rewrite of the Linux re-exec proxy
groups.evidence: dfff7b87 (#862) and 77e22a46 (#854/#855) fixed this for the Linux Bun re-exec path specifically. Add a GP9 case asserting the generic contract (stdin close/end/error tears the child down via escalating SIGTERM/SIGKILL, exit <2s) independent of which runtime carries stdio, so a future rewrite cannot silently drop it.

groups.root_cause: ctx_search invalid/negative limit has no stated behavior
groups.evidence: Matches D8/D10's 'no silent rewrite' spirit: an invalid limit is a schema error (fail loud), not silently clamped to 1.

groups.root_cause: D17 stats-accounting family: savings/bytes counters must reflect only real, model-visible savings
groups.evidence: D17 ('stats count only bytes kept from model text') is adopted as the single accounting rule covering all four rows: #1151 (binary bytes excluded from savedTokens), #952 (captured-but-redirected bytes excluded from the savings counter), #1252 (binary reads excluded from saved_bytes), and #962 (index/vocab growth bound uses a fixed count cap with oldest-first eviction, never a content-shape regex, per the owner's no-regex/no-truncation-as-reduction rule). Add D17 explicitly to DECISIONS-r4 so it is a confirmed decision, not a floating map-doc claim.

groups.root_cause: Snippet slicing at cut points must be code-point safe, layered on the existing byte-accurate splitter
groups.evidence: 6f699fac/678658af (#789, byte-accurate caps) fixed FTS5 bloat with a byte-cap splitter; it does not guarantee code-point-safe cuts. Keep #789's byte cap and layer a lone-surrogate/code-point boundary check on top; add a GP case with a multi-byte UTF-16 snippet at the cut boundary.

groups.root_cause: ctx_batch_execute fs-byte tracking needs a side channel that is not inherited by grandchildren
groups.evidence: c2d390a5 added fs-byte tracking via a child-inherited marker that leaks to grandchildren. Keep the feature but carry the marker over a private fd/IPC channel, never argv/env, and state this as an explicit TECH-SPEC line for ctx_batch_execute.

groups.root_cause: Adapter tool-name alias table (e.g. OpenCode's lowercase webfetch) is undocumented
groups.evidence: Add the canonical-name alias table to ADR-0008 alongside its existing host-exemption table, with one contract test per adapter so a differently-cased or differently-named tool cannot silently miss PreToolUse hints.

groups.root_cause: Honouring HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY again must not reopen the DNS-rebinding-via-proxy gap
groups.evidence: Q19 already decided: 'Proxy env: yes, with an SSRF check that runs on every hop, including an allowlisted proxy.' 42448389 ('fix(security): close DNS guard gaps from CR (dns/promises, resolve*, proxy env)', CONFIRMED CR finding on PR #476) is the commit this must not re-break: reuse its classifyIp/dns-guard pattern on the proxy's own resolved target before honouring the vars, do not simply delete the stripping lines.

groups.root_cause: Combined tool-description token budget needs no mechanism beyond the existing per-tool cap
groups.evidence: Q13 already caps each tool description at 1,024 chars, enforced by lint. Simplest path: no separate combined-budget mechanism; the per-tool cap times the fixed v2.0 tool count already bounds the total, so no new constant is needed.

groups.root_cause: ADR-0007 must name concrete fixed sources, not just a rule, for the hosts Q11 covers
groups.evidence: 98d239b7 ('fix(codex): resolve plugin-manager root for doctor and upgrade') names Codex's concrete source. Add it and Copilot CLI's to ADR-0007's table explicitly so Q11 is fully instantiated, not left as a rule with blanks.

groups.root_cause: Generated hooks.json must not hard-code one shell's syntax
groups.evidence: 89f4e736/a2c82c62/adcc2cc8 (#782/#788, MinGW path-conversion fixes, three cherry-picks) show Windows shell quirks are a recurring class. D7's hooks.json generator must emit one cross-platform script rather than PowerShell-vs-POSIX branches, matching 'no fallback chain' and keeping ADR-0017's real Windows CI green.

groups.root_cause: One shared path-containment primitive must back every exec-shaped tool
groups.evidence: d1ae5625 (#852, isPathInsideProject) is the correct, already-fixed containment check. Make it the single exported function called by ctx_execute_file, ctx_batch_execute and ctx_execute; add a GP7 sub-case running one worktree fixture through all three and asserting identical accept/reject, closing the execute_file-vs-batch_execute inconsistency.

groups.root_cause: v2 reads only Claude Code's own deny rules, not other hosts' permission profiles
groups.evidence: Q19 already decided this: 'Read host permission profiles: Claude Code deny rules only.' No ADR gap remains; v2 does not parse Codex config.toml or other host trust settings.

groups.root_cause: Hit-label/ranking format (D12) stays one open decision shared by #895 and #914
groups.evidence: Already decided in fix-r4 (res-issues-2.json, rows 895/874): D12 stays flagged OPEN, repeated-tuning history (604aba98, 837b8824, 9e29a940) shows no new finding. #914 is the same label/rank question and carries the same verdict, resolved together as the row itself asks.

groups.root_cause: Packaging tarball-hygiene regression test must survive D2's script removal
groups.evidence: f9c8d864 ('test(publish): tarball hygiene contract (F2) + measured F3 close-out') is the existing v1 fix; carry it into v2 CI verbatim so D2 removing heal/postinstall scripts cannot silently drop tarball-hygiene coverage.

groups.root_cause: Mid-session lossless SQLite self-heal is knowingly dropped by P1, not silently lost
groups.evidence: 50aafdce/a5c449df/8a1607e9 (three same-day commits) show mid-session corruption self-heal took real engineering effort in v1. State explicitly in the ADR that P1 (no fallback) trades this resilience for simplicity, replacing it with hard-error + ctx doctor, rather than letting it fall out as a side effect of P1.

groups.root_cause: Directory-walk symlink-escape containment must reuse the one correct primitive, not the broken string-prefix check
groups.evidence: f7499570 (#687) introduced a string-prefix symlink check in store-directory.ts that misflags a sibling name literally starting with '..'. d1ae5625 (#852) already fixed this correctly in security.ts's isPathInsideProject using path.relative plus an explicit separator. v2 must route directory-walk containment through isPathInsideProject and delete the duplicate, broken check — this is a v1 fix that must not be re-broken by keeping two implementations.

groups.root_cause: FORCE_COLOR/cwd-removal executor behavior has no located prior fix or regression to check
groups.evidence: No commit found for either behavior (git log -S on FORCE_COLOR returns only unrelated bundling commits); this is a feature request on the executor, not a v1 regression. Out of scope for this decision round; revisit only if a concrete executor bug is filed.

groups.root_cause: Owner-PID liveness check must read /proc directly, not spawn a subprocess
groups.evidence: Consistent with D6 (age + live owner PID via process.kill, Q7): the liveness check reads /proc or uses process.kill directly on Linux, it does not spawn `ps`. No subprocess, no fallback chain.

groups.root_cause: Pi doctor path-check parity with other adapters
groups.evidence: Adopt the reusable doctor real-path check for Pi, matching D4/D13's existing per-adapter doctor checks; low-risk, no new mechanism.

groups.root_cause: Install/upgrade must never remove user-owned hook entries
groups.evidence: ADR-0017 R4 already states this: 'user hook timeouts, user hooks, permissions.deny, MCP entries they added: kept and reported, never removed (ADR-0010).' #1239's 'sibling hooks' question is already settled by that requirement; no separate decision needed.

groups.root_cause: Per-adapter fixed detection source (D4/Q11) must be an explicit table, informed by v1's #542 fix
groups.evidence: 7e67952c/a9869a60/92a6f2a6 (#542, 6-part series) show v1 needed clientInfo to outrank config-dir heuristics for correct detection. Q11's 'one fixed source per adapter' is satisfied by documenting, per adapter, which single source resolved #542 (e.g. Pi/OpenCode use clientInfo per 92a6f2a6, Codex uses the plugin-manager root per 98d239b7) in ADR-0007's table, so implementers cannot pick the wrong source and re-open #542.

groups.root_cause: ctx_execute_file sandbox state on Codex should defer to the host, not duplicate it
groups.evidence: Codex already enforces its own sandbox; v2 reads that state rather than maintaining a second, parallel sandbox check — simplest single path, no duplicate mechanism to drift out of sync.

groups.root_cause: Code-echo-removed/summary-only rule (Q19) is global across every adapter, not DeepSeek-specific
groups.evidence: Making Q19's rule ('code echo removed, summary added') apply to every adapter, with no per-host env knob, matches the owner's no-fallback-chain / no ad-hoc-per-host-behavior rule; also keeps large raw output out of any subagent context.

groups.root_cause: D6 PID-liveness cleanup design already answers the #970 question
groups.evidence: Q7/D6 (age + live owner PID via process.kill, plus a size cap) is the confirmed owner decision; #970 asks whether this exists, and D6 is the answer — no new mechanism needed.

groups.root_cause: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR as the one named Pi doctor/install detection source
groups.evidence: Modeled on Q11's 'one named source, no fallback chain': PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR is adopted as that single source for locating an installed Pi binary for doctor/install, a different axis from Q11's project-root resolution but the same rule applied by analogy.
